Before posting, read CONTRIBUTING.md and SECURITY.md. Do not include credentials, complete configuration, real databases, private paths/project names or session identifiers. Use private vulnerability reporting for sensitive findings.

## Versions and source

- Plugin version/tag/full commit:
- Companion version/tag/full commit, or not installed:
- OS and version (WSL2 separately):
- Node version:
- Paseo daemon and desktop app versions:
- Install source (npm, Git tag, local directory):
- Provider/model, if relevant (no account details):

## Description

Which combination fails: daemon/app, OS, provider, install/update, or companion contract? Include a minimal demo reproduction and expected/actual results.

## Diagnostics

Optional, manually redacted doctor/log excerpt only. Remove identifiers and private data; do not upload complete logs or configuration.

## Cross-plugin context

If this affects both plugins, report it once and link related issues instead of duplicating the report.
